_comment: Spirits (2026-11-13, integrator E1), the HELD-fetch crack-then-cast hole (docs/design/held-fetch-crack-then-cast-hole.md). Board: two Plains + a Flooded Strand HELD from an earlier turn (a new turn: the drawn Plains is this turn's land drop, so the crack-first plans ride the LAND-DROP enumeration path); hand: Drogskol Captain ({1}{W}{U}); library: Plains filler with exactly one Island. Crack the Strand for the Island FIRST, cast the Captain with it T3, attack T4 for 2 -> win T4. Before the fix the casts were priced on the pre-crack board (the Strand makes no mana) and the crack ran in the trailing pass, so this was a T5 win at --budget-ms 0 --depth 5. Budget 0: the line must be findable at any budget.
